title: It’s definitely possible, but unlikely
pt: Foco da aula: graus de probabilidade: definitely / probably / unlikely / no chance

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Camila, the client wants to know the chances of finishing the app by March. I think it is definitely possible, but unlikely.
lines.pt: Camila, o cliente quer saber as chances de terminar o aplicativo até março. Acho que é definitivamente possível, mas improvável.

lines.en: Honestly, I would say we will probably miss the first deadline, because the testing team is still waiting for the new servers.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, eu diria que provavelmente perderemos o primeiro prazo, porque a equipe de testes ainda espera os novos servidores.

lines.en: Right. The servers are likely to arrive next week, but there is no chance we can test everything in two days.
lines.pt: Certo. Os servidores devem chegar na semana que vem, mas não há chance de testar tudo em dois dias.

lines.en: So the launch will slip to April. Is the client going to accept that, or is there a risk they will cancel?
lines.pt: Então o lançamento vai escorregar para abril. O cliente vai aceitar isso, ou há risco de cancelarem?

lines.en: They are unlikely to cancel. They signed a long contract, and the director told me she definitely wants our design.
lines.pt: Eles dificilmente vão cancelar. Assinaram um contrato longo, e a diretora me disse que quer, sem dúvida, o nosso design.

lines.en: That is reassuring. What about the budget? Will we need extra money for the delay?
lines.pt: Isso é tranquilizador. E o orçamento? Vamos precisar de dinheiro extra pelo atraso?

lines.en: I doubt it. We have a small reserve, and most costs are fixed until summer.
lines.pt: Duvido. Temos uma pequena reserva, e a maioria dos custos é fixa até o verão.

lines.en: Then I would say there is a fifty-fifty chance we stay inside the budget, and a good chance the client is happy.
lines.pt: Então eu diria que há cinquenta por cento de chance de ficarmos dentro do orçamento, e boa chance de o cliente ficar satisfeito.

lines.en: I like that honesty. Put the numbers in a short email, and explain the risks without sounding too negative.
lines.pt: Gosto dessa honestidade. Ponha os números num e-mail curto e explique os riscos sem soar negativa demais.

lines.en: Will do. Should I mention the possibility of hiring a freelancer? It is a bit expensive, but it might save us.
lines.pt: Pode deixar. Devo mencionar a possibilidade de contratar um freelancer? É um pouco caro, mas pode nos salvar.

lines.en: Yes, mention it as an option. A short list of risks and chances is better than a long speech.
lines.pt: Sim, mencione como opção. Uma lista curta de riscos e chances é melhor que um discurso longo.

facts.label: Graus de probabilidade
facts.sub: Use definitely, probably, be unlikely to e there is no chance para dizer quão provável algo é.

facts.label: Com certeza
facts.sub: Definitely indica certeza quase total. Coloque antes do verbo principal: It will definitely work. Depois de be, vem logo após: It is definitely possible.

facts.label: Provável
facts.sub: Probably indica alta probabilidade: We will probably miss the deadline. Fica entre will e o verbo principal. Possibly mostra uma chance menor que probably.

pages.title: Chances and risks · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon in an office in Seattle. Carl and Clara lead a small team. They are building an app for a client. The deadline is close. The client asks about the chances. They must answer honestly.

“Clara, the client wants to know the chances of finishing the app by March. I think it is definitely possible, but unlikely.” says Carl. “Honestly, I would say we will probably miss the first deadline, because the testing team is still waiting for the new servers.” says Clara. “Right. The servers are likely to arrive next week, but there is no chance we can test everything in two days.” says Carl.
